notes.title: Dummy Life Now Available On Steam!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/699830/Dummy_Life/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30694029/bee2a9712e08254d7480116a8cebcee96f40098f.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/699830/Dummy_Life/]Dummy Life[/url] is now available on Steam!

Dummy Life is a science fiction hacking puzzle game. Play as CYPH3R, a test dummy specialized in hacking. Manipulate devices such as surveillance cameras, security doors, moving platforms, pressure plates, teleporters, laser traps and other robots to assist you in your escape.

Have fun!
